hero.headline: Auto-reply for your Facebook store
hero.subheadline: jobabai answers product questions, collects COD orders, and screens fake orders — inside Facebook Messenger, automatically.

cards.title: Missed messages
cards.body: Hundreds of customer questions pile up overnight. You reply all morning instead of running your business.

cards.title: COD fraud
cards.body: Fake orders with wrong phone numbers and vague addresses waste your stock and courier budget.

cards.title: Lost orders
cards.body: No system means orders fall through the cracks. A customer says they ordered, you have no record.

steps.title: Upload your catalog
steps.body: Add your products — name, price, description, FAQ. Takes minutes.

steps.title: Connect your Facebook Page
steps.body: One-click OAuth. jobabai watches for new Messenger messages.

steps.title: Your bot answers customers
steps.body: Grounded replies from your catalog only. Orders go straight to your Google Sheet.

cards.title: Catalog-grounded replies
cards.body: Never invents prices or products not in your catalog.

cards.title: COD order screening
cards.body: Flags malformed phones, suspicious addresses, and bulk-order risk automatically.

cards.title: Google Sheets integration
cards.body: Every confirmed order lands in your own Sheet — no third-party dashboard to learn.

cards.title: Bangla + English mix
cards.body: Customers write however they write. jobabai understands both.

cards.title: Risk score per order
cards.body: Each COD order gets a risk score. Ship confident, flag the dodgy ones.

cards.title: Instant seller notification
cards.body: New order? You get notified immediately.

pricing.title: Simple, BDT pricing
pricing.subtitle: No USD surprises. Pay with bKash, Nagad, or card.

items.q: Does jobabai work with any Facebook Page?
items.a: Yes. Any Facebook Page with Messenger enabled can connect to jobabai with one OAuth click.

items.q: What if jobabai doesn't know the answer?
items.a: It says so honestly — "I don't have that information, please contact the seller." It never invents prices or products.
Your catalog is isolated to your account. No other seller can ever see your products or orders. Data is encrypted at rest.
